name: NGC 1439 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1439, an elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1439-hubble
story: A quiet elliptical galaxy in a sparsely populated corner of space, watched for the globular star clusters that swarm around it.

claims.text: NGC 1439 is an elliptical galaxy (type E1)
It lies in a low-density environment
Program 10554 studies globular cluster systems of ellipticals in low-density environments and targets NGC 1439
The data come from HST program 10554
